metadata.description: Personal marketplace of skills for UI, containers, diagrams, and generative and creative coding, plus a mod that cuts token cost and a bundle of recommended plugins from other authors.

plugins.name: ui-pack
plugins.description: UI/UX skills: Tailwind v4, asset sourcing, animation craft

plugins.name: generative-pack
plugins.description: Generative and creative coding technique references, sorted by field

plugins.name: reread-guard
plugins.description: Mod: refuses a repeat Read of an unchanged large file

plugins.name: turn-discipline
plugins.description: Setup skill for effort and compaction defaults, and a slice runner that works a plan one fresh context at a time

plugins.name: safety-pack
plugins.description: Guardrails for work you cannot fully review: ship checklist, plain-language diff, safe migrations, rollback plan, git safety net, deploy checks, plus hooks that guard destructive commands, scan for secrets and watch context size

plugins.name: recommended-core
plugins.description: Bundle: installs 5 plugins from other authors (context-mode, superpowers, security-guidance, context7, code-review), no extra binary

plugins.name: recommended-extras
plugins.description: Bundle: installs 9 optional plugins from other authors, such as caveman, taste-skill and cache-tax

plugins.name: recommended-memory
plugins.description: Bundle: installs ai-memory, long-term memory across sessions. Needs the ai-memory binary

plugins.name: recommended-pack
plugins.description: Bundle: installs 15 plugins from other authors, such as context-mode, ai-memory, superpowers, context7 and cache-tax

plugins.name: context-mode
plugins.description: From mksglu/context-mode: keeps large tool output out of the context

plugins.name: ai-memory
plugins.description: From akitaonrails/ai-memory: long-term memory across sessions. Needs the ai-memory binary

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: From multica-ai: behavior rules that cut common LLM coding mistakes

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: From mattpocock/skills: grilling, spec, tickets and TDD skills

plugins.name: ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: From nextlevelbuilder: UI style, palette and font database

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: From karanb192/cache-tax: keeps the prompt cache warm and asks before a cold send
